text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. Instead of just reading words as simple data, NLP allows machines to grasp meaning, context, and even emotion. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, it enables instant translation between languages, making communication across borders easier. It also drives sentiment analysis, which lets companies know if customer reviews are positive or negative. Moreover, NLP is behind the chatbots we use for customer service, helping them answer questions in a natural, human-like way. From searching online to writing emails, NLP is quietly changing how we interact with technology every day.
